classification: strict three-way walk-forward factor-subset and execution search; no promotion

design.platform_rule: for each subset require at least 7/9 execution points passing in both train and validation
design.selection_basis: train and validation only; test is a one-shot holdout

known_limits: Strict 2018 start is impossible for this eight-factor set: financial/flow fields are empty before 2021 and complete only from 2022-05-05.
The test window has been observed in prior exploratory rounds; this is a new protocol confirmation, not a fully virgin holdout.
Current HS300 membership applied to history retains survivorship bias.
The prior R395/R397 tests were already observed; R398 is the first strict three-way holdout for these eight factors.
Subsets and execution grids are correlated trials; selection multiplicity remains a risk.
Daily T+1 approximation does not model intraday impact.
Five-x cost is not a hard rejection gate.
